title: Web answers should include inline citations and a sources list
body: When web context contributes to an answer, require numbered inline citations, track the sources list, and preserve those citations through speech text and native streaming display.
interface: web access context asks for numbered citations, citation-check validates them, and speech text strips source markers safely. The tests call: `node-bot/utils/citation-check.js` exports `verifyAndFilterCitations(text, sources)`.
why: Research/verification tasks need citations if Mana is going to work independently.
